p1_grouped_split.test: 995 windows from 112 held-out recordings (94 fall windows, 16 fall recordings)

summary.leakage: SenseFi windows are 250-row slices with stride 100 of 556 continuous recordings; 499/500 test and 493/496 val windows come from recordings that also supply train windows (60% raw-row overlap). The 98% UT-HAR figure is a within-recording number.
summary.honest_protocol: p1: whole recordings held out (70/10/20 by class, seed 0). Same people/room; UT-HAR has no subject/session IDs, so cross-person / cross-room cannot be measured.
summary.best_variant: ResNet18 from scratch, per-window standardisation + realistic augmentation, test-time sanitize(); temperature 1.42 from val (models/har_resnet18_grp_robust.pt)
summary.no_retrain_fix_for_pretrained: sanitize() + align_offset() before fixed train min-max: fixes 6 dB gain offset (0.676->0.982) and zeroed subcarriers (0.348->0.976) at no clean cost on SenseFi split
summary.fall_rule: motion burst + post-event stillness on 2.5 s windows did not separate falls (class medians ~identical) and did not beat calibrated probability alone; dropped. Event-level 2-consecutive-window persistence reduces recording-level false alarms for weaker models.
caveats: single grouped split seed, single training seed
